```{r}

#focus only on PFHxS.Total, PFOS.Total, PFOA, PFNA 
library(tidyverse)
library(mclust)
library(lcmm)
load("PFAS_Cleaned_4Continuous_5Binary.RData")
#load("AnalyticData_11.10.2025.RData")
```

```{r}
pfas_vars <- c("PFHxS.Total", "PFOS.Total", "PFOA", "PFNA" )


outcome_data <-  pfas4.dt %>%
  filter(Visitmo %in% c(6, 24)) %>%
  select(StudyID.GE, Visitmo, Study.GE, all_of(pfas_vars)) %>%
 mutate(across(.cols = pfas_vars, ~ log(.)))

outcome_data <- outcome_data %>% 
                group_by(StudyID.GE) %>%
                filter(n() == 2) %>% #ensures we focus on data that has duplicates 
                ungroup() 

outcome_data$StudyID.GE = factor(outcome_data$StudyID.GE)


```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(data = outcome_data, aes(x = Visitmo, y = PFHxS.Total, group = StudyID.GE, colour = Study.GE)) + geom_smooth(method = lm)

ggplot(data = outcome_data, aes(x = Visitmo, y = PFNA, group = StudyID.GE, colour = Study.GE)) + geom_smooth(method = lm)

ggplot(data = outcome_data, aes(x = Visitmo, y = PFOA, group = StudyID.GE, colour = Study.GE)) + geom_smooth(method = lm)

ggplot(data = outcome_data, aes(x = Visitmo, y = PFOS.Total, group = StudyID.GE, colour = Study.GE)) + geom_smooth(method = lm)
```

```{r}
pca6 = outcome_data %>% filter(Visitmo == 6) %>% 
    select(PFHxS.Total, PFOS.Total, PFOA, PFNA) %>%
    scale() %>% 
   prcomp(., center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE) 

summary(pca6)
explained_var = pca6$sdev^2 / sum(pca6$sdev^2)
df = data.frame(explained_var = explained_var, x = seq_along(explained_var))


ggplot(df, aes(y = explained_var, x = x)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  ylab("Variance Explained") + xlab("Principal Component") +
  ggtitle("PCA: Variance Explained by Each PC") +
  theme_minimal()

# Biplot of the first two principal components
biplot(pca6, main = "PCA Biplot")


```

```{r}
pca24 = outcome_data %>% filter(Visitmo == 24) %>% 
    select(PFHxS.Total, PFOS.Total, PFOA, PFNA) %>%
    scale() %>% 
   prcomp(., center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE) 

summary(pca24)

df = data.frame(explained_var = pca24$sdev^2 / sum(pca6$sdev^2), x = seq_along(explained_var))


ggplot(df, aes(y = explained_var, x = x)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  ylab("Variance Explained") + xlab("Principal Component") +
  ggtitle("PCA: Variance Explained by Each PC") +
  theme_minimal()

# Biplot of the first two principal components
biplot(pca24, main = "PCA Biplot")

```







```{r}
outcome_data = outcome_data %>% mutate(year = ifelse(Visitmo == 6, 0.5, 2))
outcome_data$id <- rep(1:198, each = 2)
```

# Model-Based Longitudinal Clustering: Latent Class Growth Analysis (LCGA)
```{r}
x =  multlcmm(
  fixed = PFHxS.Total + PFOS.Total + PFOA ~ year,
  random = ~ year | id,
  subject = "id",
  data = outcome_data,
  ng = 1
)

x 

x$best
```


```{r}
data = outcome_data %>% filter(Visitmo == 6) %>% select(PFHxS.Total)
BIC = mclustBIC(data) 
mod1 = Mclust(data  , x = BIC)

table(mod1$classification)
```

```{r}

library(kohonen)

# Prepare data for Visitmo == 6
som_data <- outcome_data %>%
  filter(Visitmo == 6) %>%
  select(PFHxS.Total, PFOS.Total, PFOA, PFNA) %>%
  scale() # SOM works best with scaled data

# Set SOM grid dimensions (you can adjust xdim and ydim)
som_grid <- somgrid(xdim = 5, ydim = 5, topo = "hexagonal")

# Train the SOM
som_model <- som(som_data, grid = som_grid, rlen = 100)

# Plot the training progress and codebook vectors
plot(som_model, main = "SOM Training Progress & Codebook Vectors")

# Plot component maps for each PFAS variable
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
for(i in 1:4) {
  plot(som_model, type = "property", property = som_model$codes[[1]][,i], 
       main = colnames(som_data)[i], palette.name = terrain.colors)
}
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
```


```{r}
som_data <- outcome_data %>%
  filter(Visitmo == 24) %>%
  select(PFHxS.Total, PFOS.Total, PFOA, PFNA) %>%
  scale() # SOM works best with scaled data

# Set SOM grid dimensions (you can adjust xdim and ydim)
som_grid <- somgrid(xdim = 5, ydim = 5, topo = "hexagonal")

# Train the SOM
som_model <- som(som_data, grid = som_grid, rlen = 100)

# Plot the training progress and codebook vectors
plot(som_model, main = "SOM Training Progress & Codebook Vectors")

# Plot component maps for each PFAS variable
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
for(i in 1:4) {
  plot(som_model, type = "property", property = som_model$codes[[1]][,i], 
       main = colnames(som_data)[i], palette.name = terrain.colors)
}
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
```
